name: PanVK Kbase — RC5-universal-112
displayVersion: RC5-universal-112 (Mesa 5a07217f, csf-v11 018-229 + jm-v9 + jm-v7 + jm-v7-wip 0006-0092; v6/v7/v9/v10/v11 in one .so)
author: abhay-byte
description: Experimental PanVK driver for Mali GPUs on mali_kbase: Bifrost JM v6/v7, Valhall JM v9 and CSF v10-v14 in one .so. RC5-universal-112 cuts driver-internal memory on CSF (smaller tiler heaps and TERM backlog, BC raw stores no longer pinned or switched on device-wide, command pool auto-trim, outgrown TLS freed, small u_trace heap), fixes a BC copy path that could leave textures black, and adds PANVK_DEBUG=mem accounting. Bundled in this APK.
